# P2 — Content model, i18n, seed

## Five kinds of text cell

`field` (owned by the editor) · `setting` (site chrome) · `derived` (counts, pagination, filter chips, prev/next,
related, TOC) · `static` (kit/marketing samples) · `unsupported` (content-gaps). Every piece of text on screen
must fall into exactly one kind and be recorded in `content-model.md`.

## Rules for creating collections

- **Singleton** = collection with `routable: false`, `urlPattern: "/about"` (literal — without it hreflang
  becomes `/about/about`), one entry per locale, `supports: ["revisions","seo"]`. The admin gets a labelled form
  instead of raw JSON. Northgate: `site`, `home`, `about`, `services_page`, `projects_page`, `news_page`,
  `careers`, `investors`, `contact`.
- **Flat list** = core's `repeater` (sub-fields: string/text/url/number/integer/boolean/
  datetime/select/image). **No nesting**: where nesting is needed, use a separate collection (`services`,
  `projects`, `posts`, `vacancies`).
- `reference` holds **one** id (`allowMultiple` is not validated) — several references = several fields.
- Optional link sub-fields use `string`, not `url` (`url` refuses the empty string = "no file yet").
- Figures/text that contradict each other across pages: a field **of that page**, not "normalised".
- `posts` needs a `date` field (datetime, `dateField`) — the seed cannot set `published_at`.
- Sample text is a **template**: `count_label: "{count} articles"`, `page_meta: "{page} of {pages} · {perPage}
  per page"`, `search_results_line: "{count} results for “{query}”"`.

## i18n

Row-per-locale: entries, taxonomy defs, terms, menus all have `locale` + `translationOf` (a seed-local id
`coll:slug:locale`). EN first, RU after in the seed. Same slug in both locales (reversible). Custom-URL menus have
the `/ru` prefix. Astro: `defaultLocale` has no prefix; **no** `fallback`.

## Seed

Generated by code — not hand-written: the **kit's** `tools/compile-seed.mjs` reads `seed/site-model.json`
(the source contract, [`site-model.md`](site-model.md)). Templates built before 15/09/2026 still keep
their own `tools/build-seed.mjs` until there is an adapter emitting the contract from the original source. Check with
`node tools/validate-seed.mjs seed/seed.json` (EmDash's validator). The seed **carries no media** (D14):
the builder writes `seed/media-map.json` (`key`, `file`, `alt`, `sha256`, `targets[{collection,slug,locale,path}]`,
the path may be `gallery[2].image`, `content[9].asset`, `sample.decks[0].href`, `hero_cta2_url`) and copies the
files into `seed/media/<source path>` (keyed by **path**, not by basename — two locales have
decks with the same name). Long articles → Portable Text built from fields (block/h2/blockquote/bullet/image); articles
without a body → one excerpt paragraph, record a gap.

Forms are not in the seed: `tools/forms.json` follows the Forms plugin schema (`pages[].fields[]`,
`settings`), created/updated by `seed-apply forms`; the form id is written into a page field
(`contact.form_id`, `news_page.newsletter_form_id`). Checkbox: `defaultValue: "true"`. No `file` fields
(the 0.37 plugin route does not parse multipart).

## Minimum plugin matrix

core (`search`, `seo`, `repeater`, i18n) · `@emdash-cms/plugin-forms` · `@emdash-cms/plugin-audit-log` ·
`emdash-smtp` (Generic SMTP → Mailpit locally). No third-party SEO plugin (peer mismatch), no Field Kit,
no sitemap plugin (core has `/sitemap.xml`; the HTML sitemap is built from the menu).
